  <!-- 1. Hero -->
  <section class="hero" aria-labelledby="hero-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="hero-copy">
        <h1 id="hero-title">Mathematics, worked out in the open.</h1>
        <p class="lede" style="margin-top:1.6rem">Epsilon Commons is a student-led community for studying, discussing and writing mathematics together. Problems, notes and papers are kept in the open, with every change on record.</p>
        <p class="actions">
          <a class="btn-p" href="wiki/index.html">Explore the wiki</a>
          <a class="btn-s" href="#join">How to take part</a>
        </p>

  <!-- 2. Epsilon, scroll-driven -->
  <section class="eps" id="epsilon" aria-label="What a limit means">
    <div class="eps-stage">
      <div class="wrap eps-grid">
        <div class="eps-steps">
          <div class="eps-step on">
            <h2>Every limit starts with an <span>&epsilon;</span>.</h2>
            <p>Someone picks a tolerance &epsilon;, a distance from the limit <i>L</i>, as small as they like. That is the band you see. Keep scrolling and it narrows.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="eps-step">
            <h2>Then you must answer with an <i>N</i>.</h2>
            <p>To say the curve approaches <i>L</i>, you have to name a point <i>N</i> beyond which it stays inside the band. Shrink &epsilon;, and <i>N</i> has to move to the right.</p>
          </div>
          <div class="eps-step">
            <h2>However small, an <i>N</i> exists.</h2>
            <p>That is the whole definition: for every &epsilon; &gt; 0 there is an <i>N</i> such that |<i>f</i>(<i>x</i>) &minus; <i>L</i>| &lt; &epsilon; whenever <i>x</i> &gt; <i>N</i>. A proof of convergence is a way of finding <i>N</i> from &epsilon;.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <figure class="eps-fig">
          <svg class="eps-svg" viewBox="0 40 960 390" role="img" aria-labelledby="eps-t eps-d">
            <title id="eps-t">A curve settling into a band around its limit</title>
            <desc id="eps-d">A curve oscillates with shrinking swings around a horizontal line L. A shaded band of half-width epsilon surrounds L. A dotted vertical line marks N, the point after which the curve stays inside the band. As epsilon shrinks, N moves to the right.</desc>
            <g class="g" aria-hidden="true"><line x1="60" y1="40" x2="60" y2="420"/><line x1="60" y1="420" x2="900" y2="420"/><line x1="60" y1="96" x2="900" y2="96"/><line x1="60" y1="163" x2="900" y2="163"/><line x1="60" y1="297" x2="900" y2="297"/><line x1="60" y1="364" x2="900" y2="364"/></g>

          <p class="readout"><span>&epsilon; = <b id="read-eps">0.36</b></span><span><i>N</i> &asymp; <b id="read-n">4.7</b></span></p>
        </figure>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 3. About -->
  <section class="about" aria-labelledby="about-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="reveal">
        <h2 id="about-title">A space for curious minds.</h2>
        <p class="section-intro">Mathematics grows when people share it. Epsilon Commons began as two WhatsApp groups of students from several institutes, and it is becoming a place where that work is kept, checked and built on.</p>
      </div>
      <ul class="principles">
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:1"><h3>Learn</h3><p>Rigorous resources, careful explanations and problems worth thinking about.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:2"><h3>Collaborate</h3><p>Notes, expositions and projects written by many hands, with every contribution reviewed.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:3"><h3>Build</h3><p>Turn ideas into lasting work: wiki pages, papers and, in time, formally verified proofs.</p></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 4. Features -->
  <section class="features" aria-labelledby="feat-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="reveal">
        <h2 id="feat-title">What we are building.</h2>
        <p class="section-intro">Some of this exists today and some is on the way. Each piece is marked, so you know which is which.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="bento">
        <div class="panel w4 reveal" style="--i:1"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 3h9l5 5v13H6zM15 3v5h5M9 13h8M9 17h8"/></svg><h3>Working papers</h3><p>LaTeX sources live in Git and the PDF is built from them automatically, so every revision and every author is on record.</p><div class="flow"><code>main.tex</code> <span>builds into</span> <code>paper.pdf</code></div><span class="chip">Coming soon</span></div>
        <a class="panel c reveal" style="--i:2" href="wiki/index.html"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="2"/><circle cx="18" cy="8" r="2"/><circle cx="12" cy="18" r="2"/><path d="M8 6.5l8 1M7.2 7.8l3.8 8.4M16.8 9.8l-3.8 6.4"/></svg><h3>Wiki</h3><p>Definitions, results, examples and reading lists, each page reviewed before it is published.</p><span class="chip open">Open, still empty</span></a>
        <div class="panel v reveal" style="--i:1"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 5h16v11H10l-4 4v-4H4z"/></svg><h3>Discussions</h3><p>Threaded, searchable conversation attached to pages and problems, using GitHub Discussions.</p><span class="chip">Coming soon</span></div>
        <div class="panel reveal" style="--i:2"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 4h3l7 16M11.5 11.5L6 20"/></svg><h3>Lean and formalisation</h3><p>A place to develop and document formally verified mathematics.</p><span class="chip">Coming soon</span></div>
        <a class="panel c reveal" style="--i:3" href="#join"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="6" r="2"/><circle cx="5" cy="18" r="2"/><circle cx="19" cy="18" r="2"/><path d="M11 8l-5 8M13 8l5 8M7 18h10"/></svg><h3>Community</h3><p>Study groups, reading groups and shared projects, today on WhatsApp.</p><span class="chip active">Active</span></a>
        <div class="panel w6 reveal" style="--i:1"><svg class="ic" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 4h4v16H5zM11 4h4v16h-4zM17 6.2l3.6 1-4 13-3.6-1z"/></svg><h3>Library and problem sets</h3><p>Curated notes, textbooks, exercises and solutions, so that a good explanation is written once and found by everyone after.</p><span class="chip">Coming soon</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 5. Areas -->
  <section class="areas" aria-labelledby="areas-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="reveal">
        <h2 id="areas-title">Where we plan to start.</h2>
        <p class="section-intro">These are the first areas we want to write about. Nothing here is published yet, and the list will follow what our members actually work on.</p>
      </div>
      <ul class="area-list">
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:1">Real analysis</li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:2">Algebra and number theory</li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:3">Graph theory and combinatorics</li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:4">Topology and geometry</li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:5">Probability</li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:6">Logic and formalisation in Lean</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- 6. Community -->
  <section class="join" id="join" aria-labelledby="join-title">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="reveal">
        <h2 id="join-title">Mathematics is better when shared.</h2>
        <p class="section-intro">Ideas move through three stages, from a quick question to a permanent, citable record.</p>
      </div>
      <ol class="flow-steps">
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:1"><h3>Ask</h3><p>Quick questions and half-formed ideas start in our WhatsApp groups.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:2"><h3>Discuss</h3><p>Longer threads belong in GitHub Discussions, where they can be followed, searched and linked.</p></li>
        <li class="reveal" style="--i:3"><h3>Record</h3><p>What is settled becomes a wiki page or a paper, with every edit and author on record.</p></li>
      </ol>
      <p class="actions reveal">
        <a class="btn-p" href="https://github.com/epsiloncommons/epsiloncommons.github.io" rel="noopener">View the project on GitHub</a>
        <a class="btn-s" href="about.html">Read about us</a>
      </p>
    </div>
  </section>

      <h2 id="final-title" class="reveal">Ready to explore mathematics together?</h2>
      <p class="section-intro reveal" style="--i:1">Join a growing community of learners building a shared world of mathematics, one reviewed contribution at a time.</p>
